count_discrepancy.claim: NEXT_STEPS_AND_DIVISION.md §1: '12 场景中 5 个 real-random=0'
count_discrepancy.why: at L16/t=600 only 2 scenarios reach 1.000 on BOTH arms and exactly 2 have a zero gap, so '5' does not reproduce here. The 5/12 figure in EXPERIMENTS.md §5.6 (D3) was measured on the L14/t=400 best cell, whose features are NOT in cache, so it cannot be re-derived on this machine — it is neither confirmed nor refuted by E9, and must not be silently replaced by the L16/t=600 count.

per_scenario_mean.undefined_reason: AUC_real < 0.5 — the training-share denominator (A-0.5) is negative, so D1 is undefined rather than small. Excluded from BOTH means so the two sides average over the same scenario set.

caveats: the two means (pooled vs per-scenario) are different quantities and are reported separately per E9_PREREG.md §3; neither is promoted to 'the' main result
shadow_camera has AUC_real 0.3662 and is excluded from both per-scenario means: D1's denominator is negative there, so it is undefined rather than small
the per-scenario spread is enormous (0.00% to 63.82% on 50-80 clips each), which is the real finding: LikePhys is not one task
